name: ORAD-3D
summary: 面向越野自动驾驶的多天气、多地形三维数据集，并包含越野世界模型和轨迹规划基准。
summaryEn: A multi-weather, multi-terrain 3D off-road driving dataset with world-model and trajectory-planning benchmarks.
scale: Large-scale off-road scenes; approximately 350 GB release
scaleZh: 大规模越野场景，发布包约 350 GB
license: See ModelScope and Baidu dataset terms
licenseZh: 见 ModelScope 和百度数据条款
access: Public release on ModelScope and Baidu Cloud
accessZh: 已在 ModelScope 和百度云公开发布
verdict: 直接包含越野环境世界模型任务的自动驾驶数据集
verdictEn: An autonomous-driving dataset with an explicit off-road world-model task
wmNote: 真实轨迹、三维占用和未来路径预测可直接用于驾驶世界模型。
wmNoteEn: Real trajectories, 3D occupancy, and future-path prediction directly support driving world models.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2510.16500] Advancing Off-Road Autonomous Driving: The Large-Scale ORAD-3D Dataset and Comprehensive Benchmarks
evidence.statement: The paper explicitly defines an off-road world-model evaluation track; retain that track, not static free-space detection as inclusion evidence.
